triage: review-gate SKILL.md § Triage governs: render EVERY finding as a full table row, never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone; max 2 rounds, append decisions.md and COMMIT it with this artifact.

findings.title: R2-1 still open: module decision still consumes notice on display
findings.body: The module-level decision still says the UI reads and deletes the persisted notice. That directly contradicts stories 64–64c and the later decision at line 192, which requires an explicit acknowledgment command and successful persistence before deletion. An engineer following the module breakdown can therefore reintroduce the exact failure: rendering the popup permanently consumes the only explanation for already-broadened rules, even if the popup immediately closes.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite this decision so UI reads are explicitly side-effect-free and only a successfully persisted acknowledgment command may remove the notice.

findings.title: New high: v1 retirement runs before legacy filters materialize
findings.body: The new chain runs v2→v3 before validation. In the current repository, validation calls `backfillProfile`, which calls `migrateProfileFilters`; that step converts legacy v1 profile filters into `requestMethods`, `initiatorDomains`, `tabDomains`, and `expiresAt`. A literal implementation therefore strips/counts no such fields during v2→v3, then recreates them after the destructive gate and commits the result as v3. The migration will not run again, leaving retired hidden conditions or potentially rejecting the v1 state. The test at line 246 seeds already-materialized Conditions/methods, so it misses this representation and cannot prove v1/v2 convergence or an accurate notice count.
findings.recommendation: Materialize legacy profile filters before v2→v3 retirement, or make v2→v3 explicitly consume legacy `profile.filters`. Add an authoritative v1 fixture containing HEAD/CONNECT/OTHER, initiator-domain, tab-domain, and time filters; assert all derived retired fields are removed, counted, reported, and absent after rereading committed v3.
